title: Law to study tourism's effects on DUMBO
summary: This bill would require the city's economic development contractor to study how tourism affects DUMBO's sanitation, safety, environment, vending, mobility, transportation and economic development. It would require a report with recommendations, including on interagency enforcement coordination, within 6 months of the contract's execution. The report would go to the mayor, Council speaker, Brooklyn borough president and local Council members, and be posted online.
